prior_suggestions.start_name: Baltim South West offshore production platform (Nile Delta, ~12 km off Baltim coast, ~25 m water depth)
prior_suggestions.end_name: Baltim coast landfall (near Baltim, Kafr el-Sheikh) - tie-in to the onshore leg (P7578)
prior_suggestions.corridor_desc: The sub-sea leg runs ~18 km roughly southward across the shallow Mediterranean shelf from the Baltim SW platform to a landfall on the Nile Delta coast at/near Baltim (Kafr el-Sheikh governorate), where it ties into the ~25 km onshore leg (P7578) continuing to the Abu Madi gas plant. Endpoints are sourced (NS Energy: field ~12 km offshore, ~25 m water, feeding Abu Madi via a 44 km / 26 in line; the 18 km marine + 25 km onshore split from sfegypt.com). Exact seabed alignment is not published, so the corridor is bounded by the platform location and the Baltim landfall rather than a surveyed route. Platform lat/lon is derived from Baltim town (~31.558N, 31.096E) offset ~12 km north; treat as approximate.

prior_suggestions.start_name: Baltim SW landfall (Mediterranean coast near Baltim), Kafr El Sheikh, Egypt
prior_suggestions.end_name: Abu Madi Gas Plant, Nile Delta, Egypt
prior_suggestions.corridor_desc: Onshore segment (~25 km, 26 in) of the Baltim South West export line. It begins where the 18 km offshore line comes ashore on the Mediterranean coast of Kafr El Sheikh governorate (landfall near the town of Baltim, east of Lake Burullus) and runs roughly south/southeast inland across the northeastern Nile Delta to the existing Abu Madi Gas Plant. Endpoints are sourced (Eni names Abu Madi Gas Plant; sfegypt gives the 25 km onshore length and Baltim landfall); the precise landfall point and exact alignment are not published, so treat the corridor as an ~25 km coast-to-Abu-Madi band rather than a surveyed route. Coordinates are approximate, derived from the named places (Baltim town ~31.55N/31.10E; Abu Madi ~31.30N/31.37E) and are consistent with a ~25 km onshore run.
